info.title: UberLLM API
info.summary: One API key for text, image, video, music and speech models, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible.
info.description:
UberLLM is an API for text, image, video, music and speech models. Each request is sent to an available third-party provider for the model you name and billed what that provider charged, with no UberLLM fee on requests. Accounts are prepaid (card top-ups from $5); every request is listed with its cost in Dashboard → Activity.

* OpenAI-compatible base URL: `https://api.uberllm.dev/v1` (`/chat/completions`, `/responses`, `/images`, `/audio`, `/models`).
* Anthropic-compatible base URL: `https://api.uberllm.dev` (`/v1/messages`).
* Model ids contain slashes (`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`). In `/v1/models/{model_id}` send them unescaped: `/v1/models/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`.
* Errors use the OpenAI envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "type"}}` (Anthropic's `{"type": "error", "error": {...}}` on `/v1/messages`).

Guides: https://uberllm.dev/docs · Machine-readable summary and live prices: https://uberllm.dev/llms.txt · MCP server (Streamable HTTP, same key): https://api.uberllm.dev/mcp

post.description: OpenAI Chat Completions on every chat model. The body is forwarded to the provider, so standard OpenAI fields (`tools`, `response_format`, `reasoning`, `temperature`, …) work where the model supports them. UberLLM adds `models` (fallbacks), `provider` (routing) and `metadata` (tags). Failed attempts are retried before the first byte; a request that fails is not billed.

200.description: The completion, or a stream of `chat.completion.chunk` events ending with `data: [DONE]`. `usage.cost_usd` is what the request was billed.

schema.description: Server-sent events (sent when the request has `"stream": true`).

post.summary: Create a response (OpenAI Responses API, stateless)
post.description: OpenAI's Responses API on every chat model. Stateless: send the whole conversation in `input` each call. `previous_response_id`, `conversation`, `background: true`, `item_reference` items and stored `prompt` templates are refused with `400 unsupported_parameter`. Hosted tools (web_search, file_search, …) are left out of the request.

example.input: What is the capital of France?

200.description: A `response` object, or `response.*` server-sent events when `stream` is true.

schema.description: Server-sent events (sent when the request has `"stream": true`).

post.description: Anthropic's Messages API on every chat model (Claude Code and the Anthropic SDKs work with base URL `https://api.uberllm.dev`). The key may also be sent as `x-api-key`. Errors use Anthropic's error shape.

200.description: A message, or Anthropic server-sent events when `stream` is true (the cost is in the `usage` of `message_delta`).

schema.description: Server-sent events (sent when the request has `"stream": true`).

4XX.description: Refused (Anthropic error shape); nothing was charged.

5XX.description: No provider could serve it, or a temporary problem (Anthropic error shape); nothing was charged.

post.summary: Count the input tokens of a message request
post.description: Takes the same body as `POST /v1/messages` and answers with the input token count (text, tools, images and documents) that the request's hold is sized on. Free.

4XX.description: Refused (Anthropic error shape); nothing was charged.

5XX.description: No provider could serve it, or a temporary problem (Anthropic error shape); nothing was charged.

get.summary: List models you can call now
get.description: Every model a request can be routed to right now, with live prices. Without `type` the list is chat models only. Works without a key (per-IP limited, cached 30 s).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `chat`, `image`, `video`, `music`, `speech`, `transcription`, `audio` (speech and transcription) or `all`; several may be joined with commas.

get.summary: List model aliases and what they stand for now
get.description: `best-price:<job>` and `fastest:<job>` aliases that resolve right now, with the model each picks. Works without a key.

One model with its price, limits and, for a media model, `parameters`: a JSON Schema of the request body it takes. Model ids contain slashes: send them unescaped (`/v1/models/fal-ai/vidu/q3/text-to-video/turbo`). An alias such as `best-price:chat` answers with the model it stands for and `alias` set. Works without a key.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: Model id or alias, slashes unescaped.

example.prompt: a red apple on a white table

200.description: The images (`data`), or a `Quote` when `validate` is true.

post.description: Send the source picture in `image` (or `image_url`, `input_images`, `images`), as JSON or as a multipart upload. Masks are not supported. No source picture: `400 image_required`.

200.description: The images, or a `Quote` when `validate` is true.

example.prompt: a red ball bouncing on green grass

200.description: A `Quote` when `validate` is true, or the ended job of a repeated `Idempotency-Key`.

get.description: HTTP 202 while the job runs, 200 once it has ended. Poll every 5–10 seconds, or send `callback_url` when starting it.

202.description: The job is queued or running.

delete.summary: Ask to stop a video job
delete.description: A request to stop, not a promise: a job the provider finishes anyway ends `succeeded` and is billed; one it stops ends `canceled` and costs nothing.

200.description: A `Quote` when `validate` is true, or the ended job of a repeated `Idempotency-Key`.

202.description: The job is queued or running.

delete.summary: Ask to stop a music job

get.description: The file a job made (`results[].url`). Video and music files are kept about 3 hours after the job ends, image links about 15 minutes; after that `404 artifact_expired`.

post.description: The answer is the audio file. Its cost is in the `X-UberLLM-Cost-USD` header. Billed per started 1K characters of `input`.

200.description: The audio (or a `Quote` as JSON when `validate` is true).

post.description: Multipart form with `file` and `model`. Billed per minute of audio; files up to 40 MB. UberLLM's own fields go in the form too and are never sent to the model.

200.description: The text. `json` (default) carries `usage.cost_usd`; `text`, `srt` and `vtt` answers carry the cost only in the header.

post.summary: Price a media request and hold the price 15 minutes
post.description: Takes the same body as an image, video, music or speech request (for a transcription: `model` and `duration_seconds`). Nothing is charged or held. Send the request with the returned `quote_id` within 15 minutes to be billed at most `max_cost_usd`.
PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, HEIC or AVIF, up to 10 MB, kept 24 hours, at most 500 per account. Use the id or `url` anywhere a source picture goes.

bearerAuth.description: An UberLLM API key (`ull_…`) from https://uberllm.dev/dashboard/keys: `Authorization: Bearer ull_…`.

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: The same key in Anthropic's header.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any unique string. Repeating the same request with the same key within 24 hours returns the same job; the same key with a different request is refused with `409 idempotency_key_reused`.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's id, the same as its row in Dashboard → Activity.

X-UberLLM-Cost-USD.description: What the call cost in US dollars (absent on streams: read `usage.cost_usd`).

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests this key may send per minute.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: When the window starts over (Unix seconds).

BadRequest.description: The request was refused; nothing was charged. `code` says why (`invalid_request`, `context_length_exceeded`, `tools_not_supported`, `wrong_endpoint`, `max_price_exceeded`, `unsupported_routing_option`, `image_required`, `max_cost_too_low`, `quote_mismatch`, …).

error.message: Missing API key. Provide it as 'Authorization: Bearer ull_...'.

PaymentRequired.description: `insufficient_credits` (top up at Dashboard → Credits) or `key_spend_cap_exceeded` (the key's spend limit).

RateLimited.description: `rate_limited` (the key's per-minute limit) or `too_many_files`. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.

Unavailable.description: `no_available_provider` (nobody can serve the model right now, after automatic retries), `no_timing_data` or `service_unavailable`. Nothing was charged.

Metadata.description: Your own tags (up to 16 text values; keys up to 64 characters without a colon). Stored with the request, shown in Activity and the CSV export, never sent to a provider.

ChatProvider.description: Routing options. An option UberLLM cannot apply is refused with `400 unsupported_routing_option`.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI Chat Completions body. Fields not listed here are forwarded to the provider as sent.

model.description: A model id from `GET /v1/models`, an alias (`best-price:chat`, `fastest:chat`) or an id with a `:floor` / `:nitro` suffix.

models.description: Fallback model ids, tried in order only when the one before cannot be served right now (`no_available_provider`) or is above `provider.max_price`. At most 5 models in `model` and `models` together.

cost_usd.description: What this request is billed, in US dollars.

model.description: The model that answered (a fallback or alias target when one was used).

models.description: Fallback model ids, tried in order only when the one before cannot be served right now (`no_available_provider`) or is above `provider.max_price`. At most 5 models in `model` and `models` together.

thinking.description: `{"type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 2000}` or `{"type": "adaptive"}`. Without it, models answer without thinking where they can.

Pricing.description: Chat models: `input_usd` / `output_usd` per `1M tokens` (and OpenRouter-style `prompt` / `completion` per token, as strings). Media models: `usd` per `unit`. `list_*` is the model maker's own price.

available.description: `true` when a request for it can be served right now.

nsfw.description: `true` for a model made for adult or unfiltered content.

parameters.description: Media models, on `GET /v1/models/{model_id}`: a JSON Schema of the request body (clip lengths, resolutions, shapes, source pictures).

alias.description: Set when the model was asked for by an alias.

held_usd.description: Set aside for requests still running.

saved_24h_usd.description: What the last 24 hours of calls saved against official list prices (left out under a cent).

validate.description: `true`: check the request and answer with its price (a `Quote`, HTTP 200). Nothing is made and nothing is charged.

max_cost.description: The most this request may cost, in US dollars. A request that can cost more is refused with `400 max_cost_too_low`.

quote_id.description: A quote from `POST /v1/quote` (valid 15 minutes). The request must ask for the same thing as the quote; it is billed at most the quote's `max_cost_usd`.

max_price.description: The most one pricing unit (image, second, megapixel, minute, 1K characters or request) may cost, in US dollars.

provider.description: Only `max_price` is accepted on media routes; any other option is refused with `400 unsupported_routing_option`.

models.description: Fallback model ids, tried in order only when the one before cannot be served right now (`no_available_provider`) or is above `provider.max_price`. At most 5 models in `model` and `models` together.

image.description: An `https://` link, a `data:` URI, plain base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP) or the id of a file uploaded to `/v1/files`.

image_url.description: An `https://` link, a `data:` URI, plain base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP) or the id of a file uploaded to `/v1/files`.

input_images.description: The first is the picture to edit, the rest are references.

callback_url.description: A public `https://` link. When the job has ended and its bill is final, UberLLM POSTs the job JSON to it, signed with `UberLLM-Signature`. `webhook_url` is read the same.

output_upload_url.description: An `https://` link that accepts `PUT` (e.g. a presigned S3/R2/GCS URL); the result is uploaded there.

allOf.description: Each model takes its own clip lengths, resolutions and shapes: see `parameters` on `GET /v1/models/{model_id}`.

image_url.description: First frame (image-to-video models). An `https://` link, a `data:` URI, plain base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP) or the id of a file uploaded to `/v1/files`.

end_image_url.description: Last frame, for models that blend two pictures.
